name: vLLM FrontendArgs / cli_args: api_key field ('If provided, the server will require one of these keys to be presented in the header')
notes: Verified in the v0.11.0 tag of vllm/entrypoints/openai/cli_args.py (the module was relocated to vllm/entrypoints/launchers/ on main). api_key is Optional[list[str]] = None - the engine ships with NO authentication by default, and the control is a list of shared bearer keys checked at the HTTP layer only. There is no per-key rate limit, no per-key quota, and no per-key log attribution in this flag.
